context: 1.3 Discussion In this section, at the risk of being redundant, we discuss key design choices in our construction. A natural question is: why not simply use the Erdős-Rényi model Gn,n,p for a suitably 6 chosen edge probability p = Θ( logn n )? After all, we showed in Section 3 that such graphs have perfect matchings with high probability.
